nodes.label: Hero Image (isometric layered tiles)
nodes.rationale: Isometric illustration of two stacked rounded-square slabs: a white outlined top slab floating above a base slab with a glowing purple/violet textured edge, joined by dashed guide lines. Line-art plus gradient accent style typical of the Vite scaffold template hero graphic. A search of src/ found no import of hero.png, so it appears to be an unused leftover scaffold asset rather than portfolio content.
